data.body: Adoption-asset checkpoint. templates/AGENTS.md and templates/rebar-usage.md prescribe explicit bare assignees. examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md also permits a transition-based claim substitute. examples/agent-skills/rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md describes a claimability fast failure as a successful review even though it is unsigned and defers review. docs/assets/rebar-demo.svg uses a deprecated single-quad identifier and a bare assignee. Remediation should teach atomic claim, configured identity, dependency-order review, bug close classification, caused_by attribution, and supported identifiers. No project files changed.
